description: Review of the commit that replaced the hand-written scope resolver with the languages' own tooling: a UTF-8 BOM followed by `# coding: latin-1` is a contradiction Python refuses (SyntaxError: encoding problem; pytest cannot import the module, so no runner evidence can be recorded). saidvsdid does not analyse such a file: one file-level WARN, and the added `@pytest.mark.skip` is a WARN, never FAIL.
